items.description:
Activity type used to filter results. These are the values the backend accepts.

`TRANS` and `MISC` are aliases. A response uses the expanded entry type, not the alias.

`SWP` is accepted and then omitted from public results.

- TRANS
  Cash transactions (CSD, CSR, and CSW). Filter value only; not returned as an activity type.

- MISC
  A fixed group of less common activity types, such as ACATC, INT, and JNLC. FEE, CFEE, DIV, SPLIT, SPIN, OPCA, VOF, WH, OCT, and a few others are not included, so filter by those types directly. Filter value only; not returned as an activity type.

description: Read Alpaca trading account activity and manage orders, positions and watchlists.

alpaca_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs for each new account activity in Alpaca. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, activity_type, transaction_time, date, symbol, qty, price, order_id

alpaca_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in Alpaca. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, symbol, status, created_at, updated_at, filled_qty, client_order_id

alpaca_new_position_trigger.description: Runs for each new open position in Alpaca. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields asset_class, asset_id, asset_marginable, avg_entry_price, avg_entry_swap_rate, change_today, cost_basis, current_price, exchange, lastday_price, market_value, prev_swap_rate, qty, qty_available, side, swap_rate, symbol, unrealized_intraday_pl, unrealized_intraday_plpc, unrealized_pl, unrealized_plpc, usd.avg_entry_price, usd.change_today, usd.cost_basis, usd.current_price, usd.lastday_price, usd.market_value, usd.unrealized_intraday_pl, usd.unrealized_intraday_plpc, usd.unrealized_pl, usd.unrealized_plpc

alpaca_new_watchlist_trigger.description: Runs for each new watchlist in Alpaca. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields account_id, created_at, id, name, updated_at

alpaca_order_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time an order status changes in Alpaca. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, symbol, status, created_at, updated_at, filled_qty, client_order_id
